[[File:Steel scimitar detail.png|left|120px]]
The '''steel scimitar''' is a [[scimitar]] made by using 2 [[steel bar]]s on an [[anvil]], as long as you have a [[hammer]] and at least level 35 [[Smithing]], granting 75 experience. Players can purchase this scimitar from [[Zeke's Superior Scimitars]] in [[Al Kharid]].

Players require 5 [[Attack]] to wield [[steel weapons]].
